intel_summary.summary: US equities rebounded strongly on Nov 27, led by AI and semiconductor stocks; the S&P 500 gained 5.6% for the week, its best since April 2025. Gold rose roughly 2-3.75% and the US 10-year yield eased to 4.85%. Markets price about a 95% chance of a December Fed hike, and ECB officials (Nagel) signal further tightening after the BoE hike to 4%. Brent fell about 1.5% to ~$95 before Sunday's OPEC+ meeting on Nov 29. Bitcoin closed near $60.3k. Next week brings US ISM manufacturing (Dec 1), ISM services (Dec 3) and the November jobs report (Dec 4).
